description: Central Province - Orders as per the clauses 38 and 47(1) of the Early Childhood Development Charter No. 03 of 2015 of Central Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of regulatory requirements and procedures for Early Childhood Development Centers in the Central Province. It outlines legal standards, registration processes, compliance requirements, and enforcement mechanisms under the Early Childhood Development Charter No. 03 of 2015. While it mentions the Chief Minister's authority, the core content focuses on creating a regulatory framework rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization. The content fits the Legal/Regulatory category as it establishes new regulations, compliance requirements, and statutory procedures for operating childcare centers.
